releaseNotes: V1001 fixes the confirmed HMI primitive resize capture conflict observed in the V1000 screen recording.

Primitive resize handles are now neutral Controls instead of WPF Thumb controls, preventing Thumb's internal drag capture from stealing mouse ownership from SceneSurface and prematurely ending the resize transaction.
The existing V1000 scene-relative pointer tracking and render-frame update path remains intact; one press-drag-release now stays in a single resize transaction until mouse release.
V1000 immediate Device Scene theme repaint and Pepperl+Fuchs splash sharpening are preserved unchanged.
No HMI write authority, schema, communication, runtime, polling, AI grounding, Home layout, or protected control behavior is changed.

en: HMI primitive resize handles no longer use WPF Thumb, eliminating the internal mouse-capture conflict that prematurely ended each resize gesture.
A single press-drag-release now keeps SceneSurface as the sole capture owner while the existing continuous pointer tracking updates geometry.
The V1000 immediate theme repaint and sharpened Pepperl+Fuchs splash are preserved unchanged.
ko: HMI Primitive Resize Handle에서 WPF Thumb을 제거해 내부 Mouse Capture 충돌로 Resize가 즉시 종료되던 원인을 수정했습니다.
한 번 누르고 드래그해서 놓을 때까지 SceneSurface가 Mouse Capture를 단독 유지하며 기존 연속 포인터 추적 경로로 Geometry를 갱신합니다.
V1000의 즉시 테마 재렌더링과 선명해진 Pepperl+Fuchs 스플래시는 그대로 유지합니다.
ja: HMI Primitive Resize HandleからWPF Thumbを除去し、内部Mouse Captureの競合でResizeが早期終了する原因を修正しました。
1回の押下からドラッグ、リリースまでSceneSurfaceがMouse Captureを単独保持し、既存の連続ポインター追従でGeometryを更新します。
V1000の即時テーマ再描画とPepperl+Fuchs Splashの鮮明化はそのまま維持します。
zh-CN: HMI Primitive Resize Handle 不再使用 WPF Thumb，消除了其内部 Mouse Capture 冲突导致 Resize 过早结束的问题。
一次按下、拖动到释放的完整过程由 SceneSurface 独占 Mouse Capture，并继续使用现有连续指针跟踪更新 Geometry。
V1000 的即时主题重绘和更清晰的 Pepperl+Fuchs 启动画面保持不变。
de: Die HMI-Primitive-Resize-Handles verwenden kein WPF Thumb mehr; damit ist der interne Mouse-Capture-Konflikt beseitigt, der Resize-Gesten vorzeitig beendete.
Von Press über Drag bis Release bleibt SceneSurface alleiniger Capture-Eigentümer und die bestehende kontinuierliche Pointer-Verfolgung aktualisiert die Geometrie.
Die sofortige Theme-Neudarstellung und der geschärfte Pepperl+Fuchs-Splash aus V1000 bleiben unverändert erhalten.
es: Los handles de redimensionado HMI ya no usan WPF Thumb, eliminando el conflicto interno de Mouse Capture que terminaba prematuramente cada gesto de resize.
Desde pulsar y arrastrar hasta soltar, SceneSurface mantiene en exclusiva el Mouse Capture y la ruta de seguimiento continuo existente actualiza la geometría.
Se conservan sin cambios el repintado inmediato de tema y el splash Pepperl+Fuchs más nítido de V1000.
